rows.q: Is a cancelled job ever counted as late?
rows.answer: A job is DELAYED when it is not completed by the end of its 2-hour arrival window. A job is in SLA BREACH when it is not completed by the customer's contract deadline: Gold 2 hours, Silver 4 hours, Bronze 6 hours after the scheduled time. Cancelled jobs are never counted as delayed. [SOP-LD §2]

rows.q: How much do we credit a Bronze customer when we breach the SLA?
rows.answer: SLA breach: Gold 25% of the job fee, Silver 15%, Bronze 10%. Cancellation by NorthStar with under 24 hours notice: 20%. Repeat visit due to our error: the repeat visit is free. Full refunds require a manager. [SOP-RF §3] A customer is eligible for a credit when a job is in SLA breach, when a job is cancelled by NorthStar with less than 24 hours notice, or when a repeat visit is needed because of our error. [SOP-RF §2]

rows.q: Are technicians allowed to offer refunds to customers?
rows.answer: Dispatchers may offer credits up to 25% of the job fee. Credits above 25% and all full refunds need shift manager approval. Technicians may not promise credits or refunds to customers. [SOP-RF §4] Log a ticket with category Refund request on the job, record the reason and the amount offered, and confirm the credit to the customer in writing following SOP-CU. [SOP-RF §5]

rows.q: What happens if outdoor work hits a flooding warning?
rows.answer: During lightning, flooding or ice warnings, outdoor work stops. The technician waits in the vehicle and reports a Weather ticket. Dispatch delays the job rather than pressuring the technician to continue. [SOP-SC §4]

rows.q: Which channel should we use to send a customer update?
rows.answer: Use a short, friendly, professional tone. Send by SMS when a phone number is on file, otherwise by email. Gold customers also receive a phone call from dispatch. [SOP-CU §4]
